description: Movimiento operacional del Grupo Aeroportuario Marina (GAM) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Aeropuerto Internacional de la Ciudad de México (AICM). El Grupo Aeroportuario Marina (GAM) está conformado por 6 aeropuertos: Ciudad del Carmen, Campeche; Ciudad Obregón y Guaymas, Sonora; Matamoros, Tamaulipas; Colima, Colima, Loreto, Baja California Sur. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Aeropuerto Internacional de la Ciudad de México (AICM). Its tags are aeropuerto, aviación comercial, avión, ingreso aéreo, operación aeropuerto. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
